lyrics:
[Intro: pounding drums, jabbing guitar riff, bass]

[Verse 1: shouted, raw, full band]
There's a door around the back for the ones who know a guy
There's a number you can call if your daddy's flying high
And when the bill comes in, Lord, they slide it down to me

[Chorus: shouted, guitars slashing]
I'm not on the list, no
I'm not on the list
Run your finger down the page
I'm not on the list

[Verse 2: shouted, raw]
When the flood comes up they've a house on higher ground
When the bank goes bust they keep what's lying round
And when they pass the plate, Lord, the plate comes round to me

[Chorus: shouted, guitars slashing]
I'm not on the list, no
I'm not on the list
Run your finger down the page
I'm not on the list

[Guitar Break: the riff, twice, drums driving]

[Verse 3: shouted, hoarse]
When the hard jobs come they've a meeting or a cold
When the medals get handed out they're polished and they're bold
And when it's time to dig, Lord, they hand the spade to me

[Final Chorus: shouted, band at full tilt]
I'm not on the list, no
I'm not on the list
Run your finger down the page
I'm the one they missed

[Outro: riff, shouted ad-libs, fast fade]
Not on the list
No, no
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 132 BPM, 4/4, G major. Three chords, a driving stomp. Angry, loud and brief.

VOICE: Male tenor, raw and hoarse, shouted from the first word at the top of his range with a rough Southern-sounding bark, though the band was from California. No harmonies. Shouted ad-libs in the fade.

INSTRUMENTS: An electric guitar playing a short, jabbing, descending riff with a biting, slightly overdriven tone. A second guitar slashing chords. A thumping bass. A drum kit hit hard, with a pounding floor tom in the intro. Nothing else.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, drums and the riff. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:28 Chorus 1. 0:42 Verse 2. 1:00 Chorus 2. 1:14 Guitar break. 1:28 Verse 3. 1:46 Final chorus. 2:00 Outro, the riff and shouted ad-libs, fading quickly by 2:20.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1960s swamp rock cut live: raw, dry and loud, four players in a room, no decoration.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first shouted line landing on top of the riff at 0:10.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The targets are today's: bailouts, back doors, guest lists. The form is unchanged because the complaint is. It is deliberately written so that no side can claim it cleanly.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Anger, start to finish.
